Workshop.title: Workshop
Workshop.description: Configuration and branding metadata for the shared psychology workshop event.

workshopId.description: Unique identifier of the workshop workspace (e.g. 'main').

ownerId.description: UID of the user who initialized the workshop document.

name.description: Full title of the workshop event.

date.description: Date of the workshop in YYYY-MM-DD format.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the workshop start time.

location.description: Venue or room location of the workshop.

organizer.description: Organizer name shown on ID cards.

tagline.description: Brand tagline displayed beneath the logo.

eventLabel.description: Pill label displayed above the workshop title on ID cards.

customLogoUrl.description: Optional custom logo data URL or image URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workshop record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workshop record was last updated.

Participant.title: Participant
Participant.description: Registered workshop participant and real-time attendance status.

workshopId.description: ID of the parent workshop document ('main').

ownerId.description: UID of the user who created the participant record.

name.description: Full name and academic/professional titles of the participant.

institution.description: Institution, university, hospital, or clinic of the participant.

role.description: Role label shown on the ID card (e.g. Peserta Workshop).

phone.description: WhatsApp / mobile phone number of the participant.

status.description: Real-time attendance status of the participant.

checkInTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the participant checked in, or empty string if PENDING.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant was last updated.

CertificateSettings.title: CertificateSettings
CertificateSettings.description: Per-workshop E-Certificate configuration, organizer and speaker names, roles, and signature data.

workshopId.description: ID of the parent workshop document.

ownerId.description: UID of the admin who updated the certificate settings.

organizerHeader.description: Optional custom organizer header text above the certificate title.

city.description: City of issuance displayed before the date.

bodyIntro.description: Appreciation paragraph above the workshop title.

signer1Name.description: Full name and academic/professional titles of Signer 1 (Organizer).

signer1Title.description: Role or position title of Signer 1 (Organizer).

signer1SignatureText.description: Calligraphic script text for Signer 1 signature.

signer1SignatureDataUrl.description: Compressed PNG data URL for Signer 1 drawn or uploaded signature.

enableSigner2.description: Whether Signer 2 (Speaker/Psychologist) is displayed on the certificate.

signer2Name.description: Full name and titles of Signer 2 (Speaker).

signer2Title.description: Role or position title of Signer 2 (Speaker).

signer2SignatureText.description: Calligraphic script text for Signer 2 signature.

signer2SignatureDataUrl.description: Compressed PNG data URL for Signer 2 drawn or uploaded signature.

customTemplateDataUrl.description: Optional compressed custom reference background template data URL.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the certificate settings record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the certificate settings record was last updated.

ParticipantFeedback.title: ParticipantFeedback
ParticipantFeedback.description: Post-workshop evaluation feedback and certificate claim record submitted by a participant.

workshopId.description: ID of the parent workshop document.

ownerId.description: UID of the user who submitted the feedback.

takeaway.description: Main takeaway, impression, and feedback message.

suggestedTopic.description: Optional suggested topic for future workshops.

recommendation.description: Whether the participant recommends the workshop.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when feedback was submitted.

certificateClaimed.description: Whether the participant has unlocked/claimed their E-Certificate.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the feedback record was last updated.

/workshops/{workshopId}.description: Stores shared workshop configuration and branding metadata.

/workshops/{workshopId}/participants/{pa.description: Stores participants belonging to a workshop for real-time multi-device check-in synchronization.

/workshops/{workshopId}/certificateSetti.description: Stores per-workshop E-Certificate configuration, organizer and speaker names, roles, and signatures synced across devices.

/workshops/{workshopId}/feedbacks/{feedb.description: Stores post-workshop participant evaluations and E-Certificate claim records.
